## Wave 6 Summary

Wave 6 resolves the Q30 (FWD-C1 / FWD-C2 cross-pillar bridge) carry-forward into the regulator-structure of the §VII.AV.STATE-PROJ `L_emp` anchor and its §VII.AU.OP-PROJ sibling. The S116 W-4 workshop (`connes × lizzi`, `s116-lemp-forced-vs-earned.md`) closed the `L_emp` scheme-independence question as **PARTIAL — two ORTHOGONAL axes** that this wave authors as **two separate, non-conflated gates**:

1. **Secondary-class axis `{APS-1975, Cheeger-Simons, Bismut-Cheeger}` — FORCED** (gate 6-1, confirmation-only). `Var_a(|v_a(K)|²)` is PH-EVEN by the affine identity `Var(1−X)=Var(X)` (Sage-QQ `327477/3125000`, residual 0), so it pairs to zero with every odd secondary-class transgression `β^{odd}`. The 3-scheme spread is FORCED-by-construction at curvature-grade `n=0`. This gate is the **D1 falsifier** of the W-4 workshop (a nonzero `n=0` spread would FALSIFY the parity argument), NOT a UV-regulator-robustness test.

2. **UV-regulator axis `{ζ, Pauli-Villars, Mellin}` — SD-OPEN** (gate 6-2, **the genuine open gate**). The a₀-grade (`n=0`) cosmological-constant counterterm is **ADDITIVE-IN-TRACE** (`κ_R(K)=κ_0(K)+Δ_R`), so it is NOT annihilated by the W8-2 multiplicative-normalization cancellation (`math-scripts.md §"Scope boundary"`, S116 W4). The `B(R)` plateau spread across `{ζ,PV,Mellin}` at `K_horizon` is therefore the live FI/SD question — `L_emp = −7.046336` may carry a regulator-class qualifier.

Gate 6-3 is an **additive §VII.AU.OP-PROJ Element-3 annotation** (INFO): the ζ/PV α functional-sensitivity cross-check on the s=3 (`a₂`, `n=2`) FWD-C1 moment, correcting the W8-1 "friedrich-bar-saturation" mis-scope (FB-A bottom-K-exact vs FB-B Level-2-convergence) on the existing L12/L14 caches with NO new diagonalization.

**Carry-forward source**: gate 6-1 ← `session-116-w8-workingpaper.md §CF` + the W-4 refinement note (pin `{APS,CS,BC}` to `n=0`); gate 6-2 ← `workshops/s116-lemp-forced-vs-earned.md §"Carry-Forward Computations"` (CF-1 `B(R)` span + CF-2 additive-vs-multiplicative decomposition) + `session-116-w7w8-vanishing-test-synthesis.md §V.1` (S-5 UV-regulator FI/SD); gate 6-3 ← `session-116-w8w9-FB-scope-synthesis.md §V.1` (S-6).

**Orthogonality discipline (load-bearing)**: gates 6-1 and 6-2 are ON ORTHOGONAL AXES — secondary-class (PH-parity) vs UV-regulator (FI/SD). A 6-1 PASS (secondary-class FORCED) MUST NOT be read as 6-2 evidence (UV-regulator robustness), and vice versa. The two verdicts are independent and combine via logical AND only at the registry-coherence level (`registry:18819` two-orthogonal-pin re-tag, mack-routed). This is the framework's own four-axis orthogonality (`regulator-pin-discipline.md §"four-axis orthogonality"`): the secondary-class bridge-map-scheme suffix and the UV-regulator `a_n^{R}` axis are distinct pins.

There is **no hard data dependency** between the waves; they may run fully in parallel.

The only coupling is a **shared registry surface routed to mack** (cross-pillar-bridge-corpus §22/§23 + §VII.AV / §VII.AU registry text). Document each Wave-6 outcome for the session-end mack routing:
